_note: Views of the Cases page per case type that every user gets, for case types an instance names by identifier rather than by a fixed id (Ruben, 19 October 2026: lists that were pages are views of the case list). The /api/manifest delta resolves each identifier to the instance's case type and adds the view; an instance without that case type gets none. The slug is what `?savedView=default:<slug>` names.
